$comment: The wire contract between router-v4 and @neosmithai/cli. Owned here; vendored byte-identical into neosmith-connect at packages/cli/contract/. See contract/README.md for the versioning rules.

auth.$clientMustNotGateOnPrefix: The router is the sole authority on key validity. The CLI passes any byte string through untouched; pinned by neosmith-connect scripts/contract/key-shape.test.js.

endpoints.$environment: Names the deployment that answered, so the CLI can report the environment authoritatively instead of inferring it from the hostname it dialled.

optionalRequestHeaders.x-neosmith-project: repo attribution; overrides the key's bound project
optionalRequestHeaders.x-neosmith-tier: tier hint; the value in the admin DB is authoritative

$responseHeaders: The subset the CLI may rely on. app._expose_headers is a superset; security hardening can narrow it to SAFE_EXPOSE_HEADERS, so only headers listed here are contractual.

skus.$membership: GET /v1/models is filtered per org by _filter_skus_for_org_id, so a live response is a SUBSET of this catalogue, never necessarily equal. tests/test_router_http_surface.py can assert equality only because its fixture mints into a fresh org with no allowlist.
skus.$deprecated: Still ROUTED for backward compatibility but no longer LISTED by GET /v1/models. A client may keep sending these and they will resolve, but nothing new should adopt them and a user running `neosmith models` will not see them. Removing one from routing is a MAJOR contract bump.
skus.$cheapestForSmoke: Sealed single-model budget SKU. Never escalates to Opus or Sonnet, cheaper than Haiku — the SKU CI smoke prompts must use.
